goal: Is ke baad aap label ke saath simple goto parh aur likh sakenge, samjha sakenge ke programmers goto se kyun bachte hain, aur nested loops se nikalne wale goto ko flag se badal sakenge.
warmup: Ek bus route ka tasawwur karein jis ka rule hai: 'Agar bus bhar jaye, to seedha depot chalo.' Driver aam route par stop ba stop nahi chalta. Woh bas depot par jump kar jata hai. goto bhi aise hi kaam karta hai: program apne aam upar se neeche wale raaste ko chhod kar ek naam wali jagah par jump kar jata hai. Yeh sunne mein kaam ki cheez lagti hai. Lekin agar bus ke 20 aise rules hon jo har taraf ishara karte hon, to koi nahi bata sakta ke woh kahan pahunchegi. Isi liye log goto se bachte hain.
definition: goto aisi statement hai jo bina koi condition check kiye seedha label par jump karti hai. Label ek naam hota hai jis ke baad colon aata hai, aur woh kisi statement ke saamne likha jata hai, masalan done:. Label goto wale hi function mein hona chahiye. goto aage bhi jump kar sakta hai aur peeche bhi. Peeche jump karne se loop ban jata hai. Aage jump karne se code skip ho jata hai.
howItWorks: Pehli example ko step by step chalayein. Line 6 par label start: sirf ek bookmark hai. Computer pehli dafa us se aam tareeqe se guzar jata hai. Baad mein, jab if true hota hai, goto start; computer ko wapis upar us bookmark par bhej deta hai, aur lines dobara run hoti hain. Yeh haath se banaya hua loop hai. For ya while loop wahi kaam karta hai, lekin aap us ka start, condition aur end ek hi jagah dekh sakte hain. goto ke saath aap ko label ke liye poora function dhoondhna parta hai. Bohat se goto statements mil kar 'spaghetti code' bana dete hain: program ka raasta noodles ki plate jaisa nazar aata hai. Doosri example woh ek surat dikhati hai jahan goto kaam ka lagta hai: do nested loops se ek saath nikalna. break sirf ANDAR wale loop se nikalta hai, is liye goto done; aasan lagta hai. Lekin teesri example saaf-suthra tareeqa dikhati hai: ek bool flag jo dono loops check karte hain. Is course ka rule: exam ke liye goto jaan lein, lekin loops, break, continue, flags aur functions ko tarjeeh dein. Aap kisi variable ki creation ke upar se jump karke us ke scope mein bhi nahi ja sakte (Mistakes dekhein). Agla lesson: break aur continue, loops ke andar mehfooz 'exceptions'.
